description: This source file defines a helper class ApiTokenHelper used to generate JWT tokens for test users with different roles (admin and normal user) within the functional tests of the Web API.

classes.name: ApiTokenHelper
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods to generate JWT tokens for different user roles for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetAdminUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for an admin user.

methods.name: GetNormalUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a normal user without roles.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with specified username and roles, signing it with a secret key.
